game_title: Function Test Arena – Snowdrift Barracks Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing winter bandits.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing winter bandits. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the firewood keeper ahead. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the beacon fire by solving code steps involving tests_passed that move the firewood keeper forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the beacon fire first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Test Arena' (Week 6 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Snowdrift Barracks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
